title: Brother Victor pushed down an elevator shaft
place_text: Russian Orthodox Church Outside Russia, Park Avenue and 93rd Street, Manhattan

tellings.quote: in which case they pushed him down an elevator shaft and broke his legs.

plain: The writer Peter Levenda says that in 1968 a man known as Brother Victor was pushed down an elevator shaft and had both legs broken. It happened, he says, around the Russian Orthodox Church Outside Russia at Park Avenue and 93rd Street in Manhattan. Levenda says he was there in that world at the time, and he tells it as a sign of the dark dealings around that circle, though he leaves vague who 'they' were.
